fields.label: Scenario
fields.value: A cloud application repeatedly scales out during bursts and scales back down shortly afterward, while infrastructure costs rise and users experience unstable latency.

fields.label: Steps
value: Correlate scaling events with traffic, latency, and cost metrics
Review scale-out and scale-in thresholds and stabilization windows
Set appropriate maximum capacity and budget alerts
Rate-limit abusive routes and isolate expensive work
Validate changes through authorized load testing

fields.label: Caveats
value: Scaling caps must still accommodate legitimate peak demand.
Cost spikes can have causes other than malicious activity.
